_meta.description: Scripted interactive flows driven synchronously through lingxi_tui::events::keymap::handle_key against a real AppState. The scripted orchestrator output (assistant text, tool-use blocks, tool results, permission requests, cancellation) is injected directly into AppState the same way the orchestrator_bridge pump would, then the resulting scrollback + state transitions + permission oneshot are asserted. This is the same driving surface M6-05's parity_tui_permission_dialogs uses — no async transport mock needed.

scenarios.name: single_turn_no_tools
scenarios.description: User types 'hi', presses Enter; orchestrator returns one text message; assistant text renders below the user text.

scenarios.name: turn_with_tool_use_and_permission
scenarios.description: User types 'list files', presses Enter; orchestrator streams a Read tool use, then a tool-use permission dialog appears; user presses 1 (Allow Once); tool executes; result renders.

scenarios.name: cancel_during_streaming
scenarios.description: User types 'long task', presses Enter; orchestrator starts streaming (in_flight_turn set); user presses Ctrl-C; turn cancels; scrollback shows the interrupt marker.
